correctness.rationale: A vertex with a single exposure parent has deterministic final opinion conditional on all ancestor broadcasts; the random part is exactly its ancestral Bernoulli product. Independent descendant broadcast coins yield the distributional tree recursion and its exact MGF. Total variance gives a sum of nonnegative gate contributions, and comparing shared versus separate ancestor products gives the full covariance law. Boundary cases θ=0 or 1 work without division. Standalone exact-rational checker compared 360 independently sampled trees of sizes 2–9 by full outcome enumeration against a distinct convolution algorithm, testing complete distributions and all covariance entries. Enumeration supports, but does not replace, the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural unique-parent exposure subclass is explicitly motivated by the FJC work on stochastic information cascades, whose general calculations use mean-field approximations. The new complete aggregate opinion law, linear-work exact variance and zero-risk classification quantify uncertainty that expected trajectories alone cannot capture. Exact cancellation of two random, oppositely moving leaves under shared exposure provides a substantive model-relevant phenomenon. The finding is not an arbitrary numerical instance or mere re-labeling of a reachability count; it ties sequential opinion response coefficients to signed cascade correlations.
